name: Document Toolbox
tagline: Every tool you need to work with your files
description: Convert, compress, merge, split and protect documents — PDF to Word, Word to PDF, PDF to JPG, image conversion, compression, AES-256 password protection and more. Files are processed by the plugin backend and deleted right after conversion.

agents.name: Document Toolbox
agents.description: Converts, compresses and protects documents right inside your Talk channels.
agents.long_description: Invite this agent into a Talk channel to run the Document Toolbox where your team already works — PDF ↔ Word, image conversion, compression, merge/split and AES-256 password protection — and get results and status posted into the channel it was invited to.
